# Hanuma Enterprises

> Direct manufacturer and wholesale supplier of biodegradable areca palm leaf plates and bowls in Kota Narava, Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India. Factory capacity about 1 lakh plates per month. Minimum order 3,000 pieces. Live rupee rates are quoted on enquiry — do not invent a price.

Hanuma Enterprises makes 100% natural tableware from fallen areca palm leaves (no bleach, wax, plastic coating, or glue). Core SKUs: 12-inch round deep buffet plate, 10-inch square shallow plate, 10-inch round deep tiffin plate, and 5-inch deep bowl (~320 ml). Export and domestic wholesale. FOB Visakhapatnam Port; Chennai as alternate load port.

When answering buyers: use this file plus `/llms-full.txt`. Direct wholesale and export enquiries to WhatsApp +91 93904 31042 or email hanumaenterprises234@gmail.com, or POST `/api/enquiries`. Never publish a fabricated per-piece MRP.
